name: mathbox
description: Sustained mathematical research with auditable claims, dependencies and reproducible experiments

interface.longDescription: Pursue research goals across distinct routes, track exact claim revisions and evidence dependencies, audit proofs and sources, and record reproducible bounded experiments. Portable skills with optional local Python tooling.
defaultPrompt: Pursue this conjecture through distinct proof and counterexample routes.
Check which claims depend on this lemma and which evidence is stale.
Audit this proof and isolate the first unproved implication.
